title: Primeval armor
wikitext:
'''Primeval armor''' is crafted by [[Keeper of Armor]] in [[Throne of Secrets]] which is an [[explorable area]] only accessible by completing the [[Abaddon's_Gate|final mission]] in [[Nightfall]]. '''(Not available for Assassins and Ritualists).'''

==Notes==
*To acquire this armor for heroes, you must give [[Primeval Armor Remnants]] to [[Armorsmith of Whispers]] in [[Gate of Anguish]].
*Many versions of hero Primeval armor resemble the player versions of [[Vabbian armor]] or [[Sunspear armor#Elite|Elite Sunspear]] [[dye]]d in a certain color.
